status: Proposed native qualification input; root promotion and both routing qualifications required.
selection_basis: Post-review observed-unit subset of TRAIN-derived frozen mappings. No held-out phrase is added as a source mapping. Not a fresh blind result.

runtime_contract.source_language_confirmation: Keep existing explicit-input/identifier language confirmation; no model-readiness dependency for an approved hit.
runtime_contract.precedence: Existing exact whole/sentence-reference lookup first; this candidate only supplies source units when those paths yield no useful approved face.
runtime_contract.selection: Beginner qualification selects at most one unit, preferring content then TRAIN rank then longer unit then source offset, as the frozen primary arm. Unchanged normalized faces never count.
runtime_contract.boundaries: Native word boundaries and exact UTF16 source ranges required. Never slice an inflected word or use target-dependent dictionary alignment as source proof.
runtime_contract.protections: Reuse frozen protected identifiers/code, source case rules, explicit noun and interrogative guards. Native parity must be demonstrated; Python ranges are not native proof.
runtime_contract.presentation: Existing SourceReferenceUnit and PartialImmersionResult; no fabricated whole-message translation. Mandatory exact Japanese reading travels with the target.
runtime_contract.full_translation: Use accepted routing intent: explicit full action or lookup miss. Preserve current source slots on complete-reference attachment.
runtime_contract.density: This is a beginner single-unit increment. Greater depth and learned-word exhaustion are not solved by its availability count.
runtime_contract.deployment: Do not install as runtime assets or enable until parent review and native acceptance. No new model/runtime/provider dependency.
